video_conditioning_contract.design_only: true — contract defines runtime channels; no GPU socket opened.
video_conditioning_contract.output_scope: Multi-frame conditioned video generation with identity and temporal runtime enforcement metadata.

environment_identity_runtime_channel.runtime_requirement: IP-Adapter environment reference weight binding with same_environment_threshold=0.98 gate.

object_identity_runtime_channel.enforcement_default: STRICT for hero_prop; MEDIUM for scene_prop; LOOSE for background_furniture
object_identity_runtime_channel.runtime_requirement: IP-Adapter object identity weight from lock_strength = 1.0 - variation_tolerance.

temporal_preservation_runtime_channel.runtime_requirement: Edit rhythm and shot boundary continuity enforced across frame sequence generation.

camera_continuity_runtime_channel.runtime_requirement: Cross-shot camera inertia and eyeline vector smoothing across generated frames.

multi_scene_consistency_runtime_channel.runtime_requirement: Cross-scene anchor persistence with location_anchor_reuse and object_anchor_reuse flags.

runtime_enforcement_level.STRICT: Maximum runtime lock; failure triggers channel abort or fallback degradation.
runtime_enforcement_level.MEDIUM: Balanced enforcement; allows bounded drift with logged warnings.
runtime_enforcement_level.LOOSE: Soft enforcement; preserves class/category over instance detail.
runtime_enforcement_level.assessment_note: Runtime Enforcement Defined != Runtime Enforcement Proven — levels are design targets pending GPU validation.
